newsitem.title: HONDURAS: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: North and Central America port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

HONDURAS, April 21 - Puerto Cortes - Eight vessels berthed of which 4 discharging/loading containers, 4 discharging (2 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 general cargo), 5 awaiting berths of which 3 to discharge/load containers, 2 to discharge (1 fertiliser, 1 soymeal). 13 Vessels due of which 1 passenger, 2 to load/discharge containers, 10 to discharge (5 bananas, 2 fertiliser, 1 coal, 1 corn, 1 chemicals).

MEXICO, April 22 - All ports working normally. Tampico - 12 Vessels in port of which 3 general cargo, 1 steel coils, 2 scrap, 2 cement, 1 zinc, 1 diesel, 2 minerals. Altamira - Two in port,1 chemicals, 1 under repair. Veracruz - 15 Vessels in port of which 3 pipes, 2 general cargo, 2 containers, 3 grain, 2 sugar, 1 scrap, 1 chemicals, 1 minerals. Manzanillo - Seven in port of which 1 cars, 2 containers, 2 general cargo, 2 grain. Coatzacoalcos - 14 In port of which 5 chemicals, 8 oil tankers, 1 under repair.

PANAMA, April 21 - Cristobal - Eight vessels in port of which 5 operating. Balboa - 16 Vessels in port of which 4 operating. Panama Canal - Single lane outage at Miraflores locks until 22/4 for maintenance and repairs. 21/4 - 32 Vessels due, 33 in queue, 13 booked, 29 due. 20/4 - Actual arrivals 38, transits 37, average of booked and non-booked canal waters time 17 hrs.

UNITED STATES, April 21 - Baltimore, MD - Port working normally, 7 bulkers, 2 container vessels, 2 ro-ros, 2 auto vessels, 1 tanker, 3 general cargo vessels. 5 Vessels in repair yard, 2 bulkers waiting to berth of which 1 to discharge sugar, 1 under arrest. Both coal berths are open, the next vessel is due 24/4. Hampton Roads, VA - Three general cargo/container vessels berthed and operating, 1 bulker loading coal, 2 anchored waiting to load, 1 bulker discharging minerals, 1 discharging cement. 8 Vessels berthed under repair and/or at layberth.

Honolulu, HI - Honolulu harbour - 1 Container vessel, 4 tugs and barges berthed. Honolulu anchorage - 1 Bulk carrier. Barbers Point harbour - 1 General cargo vessel, 2 barges berthed. Barbers Point off port mooring - 1 Tanker.
